typedef pair<int,int> pii;
typedef vector<int> VI;

const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

struct Edge {
    int to, cap, cost, rev;
    Edge() {}
    Edge(int t, int c, int co, int r) : to(t), cap(c), cost(co), rev(r) {}
};

struct MinCostMaxFlow {
    int V;
    vector<vector<Edge>> G;
    vector<int> H, dis, preV, preE;

    void Init(int n) {
        V = n;
        G.assign(V+1, vector<Edge>());
        H.assign(V+1, 0);
        dis.assign(V+1, 0);
        preV.assign(V+1, 0);
        preE.assign(V+1, 0);
    }

    void add_edge(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
        G[from].push_back(Edge(to, cap, cost, G[to].size()));
        G[to].push_back(Edge(from, 0, -cost, G[from].size()-1));
    }

    int minCost(int s, int t, int f) {
        int flow = 0, res = 0;
        fill(H.begin(), H.begin()+V+1, 0);
        while (f) {
            fill(dis.begin(), dis.begin()+V+1, INF);
            dis[s] = 0;
            multiset<pii> q;
            q.insert({0, s});
            while (!q.empty()) {
                auto it = q.begin();
                int d = it->first, v = it->second;
                q.erase(it);
                if (dis[v] < d) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)G[v].size(); ++i) {
                    Edge &e = G[v][i];
                    if (e.cap > 0 && dis[e.to] > dis[v] + e.cost + H[v] - H[e.to]) {
                        dis[e.to] = dis[v] + e.cost + H[v] - H[e.to];
                        preV[e.to] = v;
                        preE[e.to] = i;
                        q.insert({dis[e.to], e.to});
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dis[t] == INF) break;
            for (int i = 0; i <= V; ++i) H[i] += dis[i];
            int d = f;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = preV[v]) d = min(d, G[preV[v]][preE[v]].cap);
            f -= d; flow += d; res += d * H[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = preV[v]) {
                Edge &e = G[preV[v]][preE[v]];
                e.cap -= d;
                G[v][e.rev].cap += d;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }
} mcmf;

    freopen("out.out", "w", stdout);
#endif
